items.title: YUM's $2.7 Billion Pizza Hut Exit Could Unlock the Next Growth Phase
items.summary: YUM! Brands' $2.7 billion Pizza Hut exit could streamline its portfolio, cut debt and shift focus to faster-growing KFC and Taco Bell.

items.title: YUM Drops 10.4% in a Month: Is This Sell-Off a Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: YUM! Brands' 10.4% slide lowers its valuation, but Taco Bell's recovery, KFC productivity and Pizza Hut's sale remain key to its next move.

items.title: Should Investors Buy YUM Stock for Its $9B Digital Growth Engine?
items.summary: YUM! Brands' nearly $9 billion digital engine spans ordering, loyalty and operations, but execution risks favor a watchful stance.

items.title: Checkers & Rally’s hires development chief to return to growth
items.summary: Peter Busse, an alumnus of Torchy’s Tacos and Yum Brands, will help the burger brands plot a turnaround after years of shrinking store counts.

items.title: Dave & Buster’s CEO Tarun Lal is retiring
items.summary: CFO Darin Harper will replace Lal, who had been with the eatertainment chain for just over a year.

items.title: YUM Stock Slides — Michigan Warned Taco Bell Weeks Before Public Cyclospora Alert, Report Says
items.summary: Michigan health officials reportedly discussed the cyclospora outbreak with Yum! Brands on July 2 and sought follow-up meetings on potential interventions.

items.title: Sweetgreen drops 7%, Yum falls 2% as Michigan cyclospora deaths rise to 2
items.summary: Sweetgreen (NASDAQ: SG) and Yum! Brands (NYSE: YUM) are the primary publicly traded companies bearing the market’s fear, with Sweetgreen facing existential questions about consumer perception and Yum managing confirmed sales damage at Taco Bell.

items.title: Taco Bell credits its loyalty program for digital sales growth
items.summary: The restaurant chain will roll out a redesigned app in the third quarter to capitalize on its strong customer-brand relationships and accelerate digital sales.
